vibration_zones.Zone_B: 1.8 - 4.5 mm/s RMS (Acceptable for unrestricted long-term operation)
vibration_zones.Zone_C: 4.5 - 7.1 mm/s RMS (Unsatisfactory; continuous operation may cause damage)
vibration_zones.Zone_D: > 7.1 mm/s RMS (Critical; vibration causes rapid catastrophic failure)

frequency_fault_associations.2X_RPM: Angular/parallel coupling misalignment, loose foundation bolt
frequency_fault_associations.BPFO: Bearing Outer Race Fault (ball pass frequency outer)
frequency_fault_associations.BPFI: Bearing Inner Race Fault (ball pass frequency inner)
frequency_fault_associations.10kHz_Broadband: Pump cavitation, turbulence, micro-cracking acoustic emission
